subject: a hare with looped stone ears
art_direction: 月白石兔的两耳合成不规则开环，铜色鼻尖映着暖光。

composition: Square 1024x1024 avatar. The distinct subject, face, object or abstract form occupies about 65–80% of the canvas, and remains readable at small size. Important features sit safely near the center with room for a circular crop, but DO NOT draw a circular frame, badge, disc backdrop or circular mask. Render a complete square background. Vary silhouette, expression, angle, asymmetry, and density as the individual direction requests. Appealing eyes and a purposeful expression matter when a face is present; never force a face onto a faceless concept.
creative_direction: Carve a seated hare from milky stone, bending its broad ears into an irregular open loop rather than tall points. A copper nose and two shallow charcoal eyes create skeptical charm. Raise one shoulder slightly, keeping the body solid and compact. Reveal subtle mineral bands with warm side light against muted blue. Square 1024x1024, centered with a distinct silhouette and generous circular-crop clearance, without a circular frame. Original peaceful design, no text, branding, or watermark.
